5 /-! The complete five-vertex theorem, with no additional geometric hypotheses. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
8 
9 /-- Every five-vertex convex polyhedron whose original facets are triangles unfolds. -/
10 theorem every_triangular_five_vertex_polyhedron (P : ConvexPolyhedron)
11     (size : P.vertices.card = 5)
12     (triangles : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3) :
13     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
14   obtain ⟨B⟩ := P.exists_bipyramid_vertices size triangles
15   obtain ⟨net⟩ := B.exists_development triangles 0
16   exact net.hasEdgeUnfolding size
17 
18 /-- Every convex polyhedron with five original vertices has an original-edge unfolding. -/
19 theorem every_convex_polyhedron_with_five_vertices (P : ConvexPolyhedron)
20     (size : P.vertices.card = 5) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
21   by_cases triangular : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3
22   · exact every_triangular_five_vertex_polyhedron P size triangular
23   push Not at triangular
24   obtain ⟨F, not_triangle⟩ := triangular
25   have lower := F.three_le_vertex_count
26   have upper := F.vertex_count_lt
27   exact every_five_vertex_polyhedron_with_quadrilateral_face P size F (by omega)
28 
29 /-- The public theorem is completely proved up to five original vertices. -/
30 theorem every_convex_polyhedron_with_at_most_five_vertices (P : ConvexPolyhedron)
31     (at_most_five : P.vertices.card ≤ 5) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
32   rcases P.vertex_count_cases (show P.vertices.card ≤ 6 by omega) with four | five | six
33   · exact every_convex_polyhedron_with_four_vertices P four
34   · exact every_convex_polyhedron_with_five_vertices P five
35   · omega
36 
37 end SixVertexUnfolding
